set.description: Drains all hope from the target, dealing {0} Shadow damage every {1} sec and increasing all other Shadow damage over time you deal to that target by {2}%. Lasts {3} sec.
Gives you a {0}% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, or Drain Soul spells.
Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by {0}%.
Increases the rate at which your Drain Life and Drain Soul deal damage by {0}%, but reduces your healing from Drain Life by {1}%.
Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by {0}% and reduces all threat you generate by {1}%.
Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by {0}%, and increases your maximum Mana by {1}%.
Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by {0}%.
Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by {0} sec and the Mana cost by {1}%.
Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by {0}% and your Conflagrate spell has a {1}% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by {2}% for {3} sec.
Deals {0} to {1} Fire damage to your target and an additional {2}% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
Gives you a {0}% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by {0}% for {1} sec. and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by {2}% for {3} sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a {4}% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a {5}% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
